metadata.task: If a sanitizer bottle is missing from the reception counter, bring one from the supply room.

plan.goal: Ensure a sanitizer bottle is present on the reception counter by retrieving it from the supply room if necessary.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Verify the presence of a sanitizer bottle on the reception counter.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot at Reception; Sanitizer bottle status unknown.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot at Reception; Sanitizer bottle status confirmed (present or missing).

grounded_skills.reason: Skill PER_001 detects objects in sensor data to determine if the sanitizer bottle exists at the specified location.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Retrieve a sanitizer bottle from the supply room if missing from the reception counter.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot at Reception; Sanitizer bottle missing from reception counter.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot at Supply Room; Sanitizer bottle picked up and held by robot.

grounded_skills.reason: Skill NAV_015 navigates the robot to the supply room to access the sanitizer bottle.
Skill MAN_001 picks up the sanitizer bottle from the supply room using the robot's parallel gripper.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Place the sanitizer bottle on the reception counter.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot holding sanitizer bottle at Supply Room.
checkpoints.exit_state: Sanitizer bottle placed on reception counter; Robot returns to initial state.

grounded_skills.reason: Skill NAV_015 navigates the robot to the reception counter to deliver the sanitizer bottle.
Skill MAN_002 places the sanitizer bottle onto the reception counter surface.

constraints: Robot must have can_pick and can_place capabilities.
Supply room and reception counter must exist in the world state.
Sanitizer bottle must be detectable in the supply room.

execution_summary.expected_outcome: The sanitizer bottle will be successfully delivered to the reception counter if it was missing; otherwise, the robot will confirm its presence.
